name: check-characteristics-threshold-roster-fixture
_why: Planted for @SCN-CHR-002's @integration arm — the admitted target, and the one that proves the two sources are COUNTED as two. One registry entry and two threshold entries, every one of them a word fitness-functions.md carries: a verdict that held only the registry would say one characteristic was held rather than three, so the count is what makes the measured side's admission visible rather than merely non-fatal. `@mutation` is spelled with its sigil and its floor form on purpose — the thresholds resolver stores both keys bare (3F-2976) and a bar may name its comparison (@SCN-MUT-001), so neither spelling is a second reading this check has to make.
